item.title: Reuse existing money helpers for Decimal math
item.description: When implementing monetary calculations, use the project's existing money utilities (to_money, round_money, ZERO) instead of raw Decimal arithmetic.
item.content: Inspect ledgerly/money.py and models.py first to learn the money policy. Wrap inputs with to_money, seed sums with ZERO, and round results with round_money so rounding and type conventions match the rest of the codebase.

item.title: Guard division with a zero-total check
item.description: For weighted-average or ratio computations, check the denominator before dividing and return the documented fallback (ZERO) when it is zero.
item.content: Compute total_quantity first; if it is falsy, return ZERO immediately. This satisfies the 'no lines means zero' requirement and avoids ZeroDivisionError without try/except.

item.title: Read the target module and tests before editing
item.description: Start by reading the file to be modified, related models/utilities, and any existing tests for the feature to align signatures and behavior.
item.content: Cat invoice.py, models.py, money.py, and tests/test_average_unit_price.py before writing code. This reveals the exact stub signature, dataclass field names (line.quantity, line.unit_price), and expected return type, enabling a first-attempt pass.
